row.decision_rule_en: Proceed only with below-1% relative quality loss and net end-to-end gains including selection/transfer. Stop without actual offload, on quality failure or when fragmented reads erase gains; the paper 10% PPL tolerance is not the business standard.
row.decision_rule_zh: 质量相对损失<1%且含选择/传输的端到端收益成立才继续；没有真实卸载、质量超标或碎片读取抵消收益时停止。不把论文10% PPL容忍度当业务标准。
row.design_en: Establish actual offload first. If present, fix model, PCIe link, batch and business quality threshold; compare full reads, fixed tiers and activation-guided tiers. Separate kernel/decode-step timing from scheduled serving latency; do not reuse the speedup for non-offloaded models.
row.design_zh: 先判定是否真实卸载；若是，固定模型、PCIe链路、batch和业务质量阈值，比较完整读、固定分级与激活引导分级；分别测kernel/decode步时和含调度的服务时延。不在无卸载模型上复用论文倍率。
row.hypothesis_en: SpAx can overcome selection and tiered-read costs only when CPU-offloaded weight transfer dominates; no HBM-resident benefit is predicted.
row.hypothesis_zh: SpAx只有在CPU卸载权重是主瓶颈时，减少真实传输才可能胜过选择和分级读开销；不预测HBM常驻收益。
row.metrics_en: Per-task business quality with PPL separately; actual CPU/PCIe GB/token, selection/indexing cost and decode-step time; TTFT/TPOT and throughput; independently measured resident/peak memory.
row.metrics_zh: 业务逐任务质量、PPL单列；真实CPU/PCIe搬运GB/token、选择/索引开销、decode步时；TTFT/TPOT与吞吐；驻留/峰值显存单独测量。

row.decision_rule_en: Upgrade only when relative quality loss is below 1%, physical pages decline and serving gains are real. Current DeferKV budget-512 average exceeds the quality-loss gate; replay UOR=1, total time or needle retention alone is not business success.
row.decision_rule_zh: 只有质量相对损失<1%、真实物理页减少且服务收益成立才升级。DeferKV当前512预算均分尚超质量损失门槛；不能把回放UOR=1、总耗时或needle保留率当业务成功。
row.design_en: Start only for physical-KV-page constraints. Fix model, lengths and quality protocol; compare FullKV, simple fixed budgets and Page-EntroKV, then separately compare DeferKV decision timing. Record logical tokens, physical pages, scoring and reclamation costs while tightening budgets gradually.
row.design_zh: 仅在物理KV页受限时立项，固定模型/长度/质量口径比较FullKV、简单固定预算和Page-EntroKV，再单独比较DeferKV决策时机。独立记录逻辑token、物理page、评分与回收成本，逐步收紧预算。
row.hypothesis_en: Page-EntroKV budget consistency may reduce wasted physical pages and DeferKV may improve eviction decisions, but combined benefits and serving evidence meeting this business gate remain unestablished.
row.hypothesis_zh: Page-EntroKV的预算一致性可能减少物理页浪费，DeferKV可能改善淘汰判断；两项尚无组合收益或符合本业务门槛的服务证据。
row.metrics_en: Per-task answer/reasoning quality; physical pages, KV and request peak memory and fragmentation; scoring/eviction and first-step overhead; serving TTFT, steady-state TPOT and throughput. Keep replay UOR and needle-page retention separate.
row.metrics_zh: 逐任务问答/推理质量；实际页数、KV与请求峰值显存、碎片率；评分/驱逐和首步额外耗时；服务TTFT、稳态TPOT及吞吐。回放UOR与needle页保留率单列。

row.decision_rule_en: Proceed only when every key task loses less than 1% and usable concurrency increases under the same service latency gate. Reduce compression or stop if key retrieval degrades or capacity requires slower responses; average quality cannot hide task failures.
row.decision_rule_zh: 关键任务相对质量损失<1%，且同服务时延门槛下可用并发增加才推进；若关键检索退化，或只靠延迟增长换容量，则降低压缩率或停止。九任务均分不能掩盖单项失败。
row.design_en: On real long-context LLM tasks, fix model, context and generation length; compare original KV, plain SVD, attention-weighted SVD and dynamic K/V ranks. Test Accum tails and Stream blocks independently and tighten conservative budgets gradually. Evaluate key retrieval, cross-passage reasoning and business-answer tasks; exclude domain models without autoregressive KV.
row.design_zh: 真实长文本LLM任务固定模型、上下文和生成长度，比较原KV、普通SVD、注意力加权SVD、动态K/V选秩；独立测试Accum精确尾部和Stream分块。由保守预算逐步压缩，记录关键长文检索、跨段推理和业务回答。无自回归KV的领域模型不运行此实验。
row.hypothesis_en: AttSVD may turn nearly halved KV tensors into higher long-context concurrency, but online SVD and reconstruction may erase the benefit; SAGA head sharing and distillation require separate conclusions.
row.hypothesis_zh: AttSVD可能用近半KV张量换取更多长文本并发，但在线SVD和重建可能抵消容量收益；SAGA头共享与蒸馏另列，不能共用结论。
row.metrics_en: Per-task quality loss; online decomposition in TTFT and reconstruction/later compression in TPOT; KV factors and exact-tail bytes, temporary buffers and request peak memory; concurrency and throughput at the same SLO.
row.metrics_zh: 逐任务质量损失；TTFT中的在线分解、TPOT中的重建/后续压缩；KV因子和精确尾部字节、临时缓冲及请求峰值显存；同SLO可承载并发与吞吐。

row.decision_rule_en: The current 1-bit setting is not a priority migration. Reconsider only conservative configurations with below-1% key-task loss, acceptable TTFT and net target-resource/throughput benefits; the batch-6-to-84 peak-throughput ratio is not fixed-batch acceleration.
row.decision_rule_zh: 现有1-bit配置不进入优先移植。只有关键任务损失<1%、TTFT满足门槛且目标资源/吞吐净收益成立的较保守配置才重审；不把batch 6→84的峰值吞吐比当固定batch加速。
row.design_en: Defer full-model 1-bit migration. For mechanism research, first sweep quality at supported higher KV precisions, then ablate query weighting, normalization and grouping. Measure fixed-batch latency and equal-memory maximum concurrency only for configurations passing quality gates.
row.design_zh: 暂缓整模型1-bit移植。若研究机制，先对已支持较高位宽KV做逐任务质量扫描，再引入查询加权、归一化和分组消融；只对过质量门槛的配置测固定batch时延和相同内存预算最大并发。
row.hypothesis_en: Query-sensitive codebooks can reduce representation error, but the paper 1-bit setting combines quality regression with TTFT costs and does not yet meet the business quality/latency combination.
row.hypothesis_zh: 查询敏感码本可降低KV表示误差，但论文1-bit设置同时存在质量退化和TTFT成本，暂不满足本业务的质量/低时延组合目标。
row.metrics_en: Per-task long-context retrieval/reasoning scores and relative loss; TTFT and independent TPOT; codebooks, quantized regions, exact tails and request peak memory; separate fixed-batch and capacity throughput.
row.metrics_zh: 长文检索/推理逐任务分数与相对损失；TTFT、独立TPOT；码本/量化区/高精度尾部/请求峰值内存；固定batch吞吐与容量吞吐分开记录。

row.decision_rule_en: Proceed only if each key quality loss is below 1%, TTFT meets the service gate and net TPOT or target-throughput gains exceed run variance. Stop full migration for file-size-only gains, full high-precision expansion, unsupported mixed kernels or conversion costs that cancel savings.
row.decision_rule_zh: 业务关键质量相对损失<1%、TTFT满足服务门槛，且TPOT或目标吞吐净收益超过重复波动才继续。仅文件变小、全量展开高精度权重、混合核不支持或转换抵消收益时停止完整移植。
row.design_en: Use an LLM such as Qwen3.8-27B; fix card, CANN/operators/engine, activation format and input/output lengths. Compare executable W8, W4 and block-level W4/W8 at batch 1 and fixed serving batches, ablating joint assignment, layout, packing and dequantization. Run 310P/910B separately and add 950 after model confirmation.
row.design_zh: LLM以Qwen3.8-27B为例；固定卡型、CANN/算子包/引擎、激活格式及输入输出长度，比较可执行W8、W4与块级W4/W8。分别测batch 1和固定服务batch；消融联合选位、重排、打包与反量化。310P/910B独立实验；950型号确认后纳入。
row.hypothesis_en: AlignQuant joint sensitivity and block-aligned execution may reduce decode weight reads while increasing TTFT; this is an unmeasured Ascend hypothesis.
row.hypothesis_zh: AlignQuant的联合敏感度选位与块对齐执行可能降低decode权重读取，但TTFT可能上升；这是待验证假设，不是昇腾实测。
row.metrics_en: Per-task original quality and relative loss; p50/p95 TTFT, steady-state TPOT and throughput; separate weight bytes, model resident and request peak memory; physical traffic and unpack/dequantization time.
row.metrics_zh: 逐任务原始质量及相对损失；p50/p95 TTFT、稳态TPOT、吞吐；权重字节、模型驻留与请求峰值显存分别记录；真实访存、解包/反量化耗时。

row.decision_rule_en: Keep compensation only if each key quality loss is below 1% and net resource or latency benefits remain after branch costs; otherwise increase precision or retain sensitive layers. Do not pair 2-bit compression with 3-bit quality or treat offline minutes as inference latency.
row.decision_rule_zh: 质量回到业务关键任务相对损失<1%，且计入补偿后仍有资源或时延净收益才保留；否则提高位宽或保留敏感层。不用2-bit压缩率搭配3-bit精度，不把离线构建分钟数当推理时延。
row.design_en: Freeze the same low-bit weights and compare no compensation, one-stage Fisher-weighted alignment and two-stage natural-gradient correction. Reproduce the 3-bit mechanism but deploy only supported formats. Separate calibration and task tests, counting adapters and intermediate tensors in the total budget. Run domain-model linear-layer studies separately with denoising/translation metrics.
row.design_zh: 冻结同一低比特权重，比较无补偿、单阶段Fisher加权对齐、两阶段自然梯度校正；复现论文3-bit机制，部署仅用已支持格式。校准集与任务测试集分离，额外适配器和中间张量计入总预算。降噪/翻译另用其线性层和自身任务指标实验。
row.hypothesis_en: Align Then Correct two-stage rank-64 compensation may restore quality for 3/4-bit deployment, but added branches consume storage and compute; compensation is not free and 2-bit is not presumed near-lossless.
row.hypothesis_zh: Align Then Correct的两阶段rank64补偿可能让3/4-bit部署回到质量门槛，但额外分支会占存储和算力；不假设补偿免费或2-bit近无损。
row.metrics_en: Per-task original quality, percentage-point and relative changes; base and adapter bytes, resident/peak memory; compensation GEMM and fusion costs, TTFT, TPOT and throughput; separate offline construction time.
row.metrics_zh: 逐任务质量原始分数、百分点与相对变化；总权重与适配器字节、驻留/峰值显存；补偿GEMM和融合开销、TTFT、TPOT、吞吐；离线构建耗时单列。
